description: Routing switch that sends one input to one of eight outputs, moving on to the next output at every trigger

inputs.text: A rising edge moves the signal on to the next output that has a cable in it, wrapping round to the first after the last; it reads high above 1V
The signal to be routed, passed through at full level to whichever output the switch is on

outputs.text: Carries the input signal while the switch is on this output, and 0V once the switch moves away

notes: the switch steps only between outputs that have cables in them, so an output with nothing patched into it is skipped
the switch starts on the first output, and Initialize from the module menu puts it back there

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
one channel only

unpatched it reads nothing; no output is written.
